name: Schedule
description: Run prompts on a schedule. Adds the CronCreate/CronList/CronDelete tools (the model schedules tasks from natural language like 'remind me at 3pm' or 'every 5 minutes check the deploy'), a 1-second heartbeat that injects each due task's prompt between turns via the prompt.inject port, and the /loop and /schedule commands. Tasks are session-scoped at ~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.cron.json and restored (unexpired) on --resume. Disable with MINIMAL_AGENT_DISABLE_CRON=1.

tool.name: CronCreate
tool.description: Schedule a prompt to run on a cron schedule or interval. The prompt is injected as a user turn BETWEEN turns each time the task is due (never mid-response). Use for polling a deploy, babysitting a PR, or one-time reminders ('remind me at 3pm to push'). Provide EITHER `cron` (a 5-field expression, local time) OR `every` (a human interval like '5m', '2h', '1d'). Set `recurs:false` for a one-shot that deletes itself after firing. Times are local. Max 50 tasks/session; recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days. Cancel with CronDelete.

prompt.description: The prompt to run each time the task fires. Required.

cron.description: A standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), interpreted in LOCAL time. Supports *, ranges (1-5), steps (*/15), and lists (1,15,30). Example: '0 9 * * 1-5' = weekdays at 9am. Provide this OR `every`.

every.description: A human interval, converted to a clean cron cadence. Examples: '5m', '30m', '2h', '1d', 'every 2 hours'. Intervals that don't map to a clean cron step are rounded. Provide this OR `cron`.

recurs.description: Whether the task repeats. Default true. Set false for a one-shot reminder that deletes itself after it fires once.

tool.name: CronList
tool.description: List all scheduled tasks for this session with their ids, schedules, next fire time, and prompts. Use to answer 'what scheduled tasks do I have?' before canceling one.

tool.name: CronDelete
tool.description: Cancel a scheduled task by its 8-character id (from CronList or the CronCreate confirmation).

commands.name: loop
commands.summary: Run a prompt on repeat while the session is open

commands.name: schedule
commands.summary: Schedule a prompt by cron, or list/cancel tasks
